encoding_notes.mutation_zero: No annotated mutation of the matrix type in the genotyped matrix; distinct from missing row or value.
encoding_notes.mutation_one_two: Positive annotated carrier; value two denotes summed variant allele frequency above 0.95 and is not interpreted as biallelic loss.
encoding_notes.hotspot: Hess et al. 2019, OncoKB hotspot or COSMIC mutation significance tier 1 annotations, as defined by the release.
encoding_notes.copy_number: Official gene-level matrix, transformed as log2(x+1), matching the portal transformation; no discrete amplification or deletion states assigned.
